title: Nasruddin's Donkey is Dead?
summary: Nasruddin came running into the village square, clapping his hands and shouting: "Praise be to heaven! Glory to the Almighty! What a miracle of blessings!"...
full_text:
Nasruddin came running into the village square, clapping his hands and shouting: "Praise be to heaven! Glory to the Almighty! What a miracle of blessings!"

His neighbor ran to him: "What wonderful news has happened, Mulla? Did you find a pot of gold?"

"No!" beamed Nasruddin. "My donkey ran away and fell into a deep ravine, breaking its neck!"

The neighbor stared at him: "Are you mad, Mulla? Why are you thanking heaven that your only donkey is dead?"

"Foolish neighbor!" laughed Nasruddin. "Can you not see the boundless mercy? I am thanking heaven that I was not riding on its back when it fell! Otherwise, I would have broken my neck along with it!"
moral: Finding reasons for gratitude even in misfortune preserves a cheerful spirit.
